chunks: Ali narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: “The woman is buried up to her waist when they intend to stone her, and the Imam throws first, then the people throw with small stones.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam or governing authority who initiates the procedure
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman upon whom the legal punishment is being carried out
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: she is placed into the ground in burial-like fashion
key_terms.يَرْجُمُوهَا: they stone her as a hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: How is the punishment of stoning carried out for a woman according to this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the prescribed procedure for rajm in the case of a woman. It specifies how she is to be positioned and the order in which the punishment is carried out, beginning with the Imam and followed by the people.
